sentences.text: The frill of Crittendenceratops features forward-curving, hook-like flanges along its central top portion.
This structure also exhibits a thickening in the parietal portion.
Crittendenceratops krzyzanowskii is the first dinosaur species formally named from the Fort Crittenden Formation.
Dalman et al. (2018) classified Crittendenceratops within the tribe Nasutoceratopsini of the subfamily Centrosaurinae.
This dinosaur lived during the late Campanian period in the Fort Crittenden Formation of Arizona.
Fossils of Crittendenceratops date from 83.6 to 72.2 million years ago.
